engine.public_verification: Publishing run41355715750 source/wheels/publication pass; all3 unauthenticated PyPI files byte-match workflow artifacts;186 fresh public-index Windows SDK tests pass.

original_study: docs/design/experiments-v1.json is immutable; its failed 10% criterion remains negative
contribution: Test original-row preservation against the existing exact directional row-split GSP; no new expressibility or first-ever theorem claim

generation.primary_population: Every heldout cell in both families, without a post-hoc subset
generation.robustness: Sparse n32 and thermal horizon12 LPs, plus sparse n32 condition1e8; each quadratic0/1, three seeds. Separate diagnostics, never substituted into the primary endpoint.
generation.data_boundary: Original synthetic sparse and hourly RC forecasts, not operational/laboratory measurements. No external dataset or credentials required. Forecast batches are not closed-loop MPC trajectories.
generation.curvature_definition: Curvature describes base P. Zero-hessian is a full LP only when all group quadratic coefficients are zero; quadratic1 cells remain convex QPs.
generation.condition_definition: Geometric base diagonal span before zeroing; a semidefinite P has infinite full-matrix condition. Labels do not claim a finite PSD Hessian condition number.

seeds.old_campaign: All original1000-1002,9000-9005,8500-8505 plus order271828/bootstrap314159 and public SDK test seeds0-23 excluded.

operating_limits.memory_policy: Poll current and OS high-water worker RSS every10ms; terminate on observed limit. This is supervised sampling, not an OS reservation or continuous measurement.
operating_limits.algebra_backend: builtin CPU in both softqp and stock OSQP; environment fixed before imports and actual wrapper defaults checked

timing.primary_operation: One prepared solver plus32 vector updates/solves and independent original-space acceptance checks
timing.start: Immediately before method/settings lookup and PreparedPeakSolver construction on a common already generated canonical PeakBatch
timing.end: After all32 solves, physical result recovery and independent objective/KKT checks; before result serialization
included: one-shot LP setup on every solve
timing.design: One isolated bounded worker per oracle/observation; process startup, generation and serialization excluded from inner method timing but included in supervisory30-second limit. Randomized complete method order per repetition; warmups retained and excluded from inference. No state crosses repetitions.
timing.parameter_selection: No timing-based tuning. All method controls below are fixed before heldout generation; no candidate-specific alpha sweep or favourable size/group/conditioning subset. Adaptive/default and fixed stock/GSP baseline policies are both registered.
timing.host_scope: Single study worker on the recorded, nonreserved host; unrelated existing workloads are preserved. No retries or cell deletion based on load or observed timing.

accuracy.oracle: Compact stock OSQP epigraph, alpha1.6 adaptive rho/scaling10, eps_abs=eps_rel=1e-10, max_iter200000; independent original-space checks <=1e-7, repair<=1e-7
accuracy.every_frame: Hard-row absolute violation<=1e-6 in declared physical units; normalized raw AND repaired stationarity<=1e-6; maximum absolute normalized Fenchel gap separately for each soft group and each hard row<=1e-6; joint dual budget<=1e-6; dual repair<=1e-7; objective gap<=1e-6. Aggregate signed gap is diagnostic only; no cross-group/hard-row cancellation.
accuracy.stationarity_denominator: max(1,||P*x||inf,||q||inf,||A.T*y||inf), separately for raw and repaired y
accuracy.fenchel_denominator: Per group: max(1,abs(group penalty),abs(group box support),abs(repaired_y_group.T*A_group*x)); per hard row: max(1,abs(y_i*bound_i),abs(y_i*(A*x)_i))
accuracy.flags: OSQP1/2 and DAQP1/2/4/5 are candidates only. No accepted batch unless every frame passes. Incompatible semantics are prespecified; unexpected unsupported results are failures.

analysis.metric: Per-instance median complete-batch time over3 measured repetitions; reduction1-native/fastest compatible preregistered baseline median
analysis.denominator: All144 heldout instances, six seed clusters, both complete families
analysis.failure_rule: Any missing, unsuccessful, timed-out or accuracy-rejected compatible baseline/candidate observation assigns reduction-1 to the entire instance and prevents qualification. No deleting failures or incompatible cells masquerading as failures.
analysis.bootstrap: Sample six whole seeds with replacement, pool their full24-instance vectors, take median; percentile2.5/97.5 by NumPy linear quantile
analysis.acceptance: Median reduction>=10%, lower95% cluster bound>0, and zero failed primary pairs
analysis.negative_result: Retain full results; no reseeding, favourable endpoint replacement or superiority claim on failure. Engineering publication remains separate from companion-app research qualification.

source_identity: LF-normalized SHA256 for every listed source; exact public wheel binary whitelist and pinned dependency versions; commit protocol/source/review references before heldout generation
registration_requirements: Independent ACCEPT receipt matching this exact canonical protocol and LF-normalized source map
